name: Mono Grid
author: Local Markdown Reader
description: System-aware compact style for dense tables and code-heavy documents.
css: .document-reader table { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .document-reader th, .document-reader td { padding-top: 0.38em; padding-bottom: 0.38em; } .document-reader pre code { font-size: 0.92em; }
